probe: GPU contention / parallel-feasibility for the epi4-CE runs

compute_processes.job: epi4-CE mask_nonepi seed 42 (killed after the test)

single_job_baseline.diagnosis: GPU compute/power-bound (SM 100 %, power at the 300 W cap,
NOT dataloader/CPU-bound: a second job cannot be absorbed for free.

contention_test.setup: masked-parity seed 42 (79,684 rows, 4-class CE on epithelial rows
only, 7,473 steps) launched in parallel with the in-flight
drop_nonepi seed 42; both 3 epochs, batch 8 x accum 4, lr 5e-5, bf16.
contention_test.verdict: throughput gain; masked-parity seed 42 killed at step ~255,
epi4 recovered to 1.37 s/step (steps 1000-1041) within ~2 min.

measurement_method: windowed s/step from the cumulative elapsed field of
each run's tqdm frames (no wall-clock interpolation);
decision: serialise: finish the epi4-CE three seeds first, then run the
masked-parity three seeds alone. The killed masked run left a
checkpoint-free save dir (steps ~255/7473) and a usable frozen-axis
cache, so the relaunch loses only those steps.
